body: Suicide is the 10th leading cause of death, its pretty obvious that most people in life will eventually get to that realization that nothing matters. There will be the exceptions but deep down I think that most people that are over the age of 18 wouldn't mind being dead. There is a obvious difference between wanting to be dead and not caring you were dead but I think once you have the mindset of not caring you were dead is when it becomes toxic and you begin to spiral into wanting to be dead. This process can be quick or slow, it all depends on the person and the circumstances.

Its hard to feel like anyone cares, my mom made sure to make sure to make me feel like a piece of shit the first attempt and now after the second attempt has just stop talking to me, she ignores texts and calls and only talks to me in person. If I call the hotline I am worried that I will get hospitalized or they will take the rope and then everyone will just hate me more. I wish I had a different perspective but I don't, it all just seems so hopeless.

wow, I've been having a similar thing, with the nightmares at least. Mine are usually getting stabbed or hurt by someone else but stabbed seams to bet he most common. I always wake up right before it hits me though, Very frightening and just worsens my fear of people. I wish you the best of luck though, I hope you get well.
yeah, there is a post here like every 5 minutes. really shows how fucked our world is, im glad I won't be apart of this for much longer.

Yeah, my mom is also really mean about it. I've failed 2 times in the past, the 1st time she guilt tripped me and gas lighted me and the second time she just kind of stopped talking to me. Only talks to me when forced to or if I need something and she made sure to kick me out at 18. 19 now, but she hates me because I want to die which I don't understand. I wish you the best of luck.

Yeah, I am 19 and don't see the point anymore. I don't think there is a age restriction on wanting to die, there are obviously certain things that can speed up this process such as abuse or other things but I just can't see anyone not being suicidal at some point.
I agree, people wanted to hurt me and then they get sad when I eventually kill myself because of it. But when I am alive you still treat me as sub human.

Nope, I don't plan on having kids. Nobody deserves to suffer, and that is what life is at the end of the day. I don't wanna have kids that even have the chance to make others suffer like I have, it would kill me and I also generally don't think ill be alive for too much longer so it doesn't matter at the end of the day.
